company.name: Couple
company.shortDescription: Couple is an app that enables users to stay connected with their partners via text messaging, video and photo sharing, and sketching.
company.description:
Couple is an app just for the two of you. It helps you stay connected, and feel close to each other. Whether it's texting, sharing videos, photos, sketching together and more, Couple let's your partner know that you're thinking about them.

Couple was part of the YCombinator W2012 batch, and was formerly named Pair until they renamed to Couple on January 31st, 2013.
